ClientProfile.title: Traveler Client Profile
ClientProfile.description: Cloud-synced traveler account with OTP verification state, Visa/Tasheer order tracking, passport metadata, and Google Drive document references.

phone.description: Normalized WhatsApp phone digits serving as unique client key.

orderCode.description: Deterministic non-PII order code for quick order status lookup (e.g. MSK-5002428).

avatarUrl.description: Google Drive direct HTTPS download URL for personal profile avatar.

avatarStoragePath.description: Google Drive file reference (gdrive:{fileId}) for client avatar.

avatarSizeBytes.description: Recorded compressed avatar size in bytes for Storage quota tracking.

otpGeneratedAt.description: ISO timestamp when current 6-digit OTP was generated.

otpExpiresAt.description: ISO timestamp (24h validity) when current 6-digit OTP expires.

otpConsumed.description: Whether the current OTP has been consumed or invalidated.

activatedByAdmin.description: Whether the account was instantly activated by Admin without requiring OTP.

adminBypassOtpAt.description: ISO timestamp of latest Admin instant activation without OTP.

pinHash.description: SHA-256 hex digest of client 6-digit quick-login PIN.

pinUpdatedAt.description: ISO timestamp when client PIN was created or updated.

trustedDevices.description: Bounded list (max 15) of trusted device fingerprints authorized for quick PIN login.

verified.description: Whether the client account has been verified.

createdAt.description: ISO timestamp when profile was created.

updatedAt.description: ISO timestamp of latest profile modification.

orderStatus.description: Current processing stage for Visa or VFS Tasheer appointment.

adminNotes.description: Client-visible note written by General Manager or Sub-Admin.

passportNumber.description: Uppercase passport number (manual or AI OCR extracted).

passportFullName.description: Full name matching the passport MRZ/data page.

documents.description: Bounded list (max 30) of uploaded document metadata with Google Drive download & view URLs.

familyMembers.description: Bounded list (max 25) of family members and companions with passport details and permanent Google Drive URLs for passport and personal photos.

issuedDocuments.description: Bounded list (max 30) of completed execution deliverables (PDF tickets, visas, Tasheer/GAMCA slips) issued by admin.

notifications.description: Bounded list (max 30) of real-time client notifications for issued documents and order status updates.

appointmentDetails.description: Structured booked appointment metadata (serviceType, date, time, location, referenceNumber) used for the client's high-contrast Appointment QR Pass.

SiteGeneralConfig.title: Site General Configuration
SiteGeneralConfig.description: Global announcement banner, dynamic phone number, working hours, and hero highlight overrides.

announcementEnabled.description: Controls visibility of the top urgent announcement banner.

primaryDriveWebAppUrl.description: Primary HTTPS Google Drive Web App script endpoint URL for cloud uploads.

additionalDriveWebApps.description: Bounded list (max 10) of secondary/scoped Google Drive Web App endpoints for multi-account failover or workload separation.

SiteCmsState.title: Site Live Inline CMS State
SiteCmsState.description: Live inline editor text overrides, deleted block keys, and dynamically added custom service cards.

textOverrides.description: Map of scoped language:key text overrides.

deletedKeys.description: Bounded list of soft-deleted editable block keys.

customItems.description: Bounded list of dynamically added CmsCustomItem cards.

AdminAccount.title: Admin & Sub-Admin Account
AdminAccount.description: Master General Manager PIN hash and Sub-Admin accounts with granular role permissions.

pinHash.description: SHA-256 hex digest of the admin PIN.

OrderStatusLookup.title: Public Non-PII Order Status Lookup
OrderStatusLookup.description: Isolated non-PII status projection containing only order code, general execution state, and deliverable availability.

/clients/{phoneId}.description: Traveler profiles keyed by normalized WhatsApp phone digits.

/order_status/{phoneId}.description: Public non-PII order status lookup records exposing only general execution stage.

/site_config/{configId}.description: Public site configuration documents ('general' for SiteGeneralConfig, 'cms' for SiteCmsState).

/admins/{adminId}.description: Master General Manager config ('master') and Sub-Admin permission accounts.
